title: 隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿~Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels
focus: 以掌子面擠出、玻纖筋黏結與開挖保留長度控制面補強~Control face reinforcement through extrusion, fibre-bar bond and retained length
summary: 本課以以掌子面擠出、玻纖筋黏結與開挖保留長度控制面補強為主線，從掌子面擠出與地層核心與補強密度與非均勻分擔建立系統邊界，再把開挖進尺與保留長度、施工時間與黏結成熟連到面補強與周邊支護協調。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on control face reinforcement through extrusion, fibre-bar bond and retained length. It begins with Face extrusion and ground core and Reinforcement density and unequal sharing, links Advance and retained reinforcement and Construction time and bond maturity, and ends with Face reinforcement and peripheral support. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 掌子面擠出與地層核心~Face extrusion and ground core
units.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心~Face extrusion and ground core
units.mechanism: 面前地層向開挖空間擠出會削弱拱效應，補強筋透過黏結抑制核心變形。量到的面位移包含開挖卸載與地層時效，不能直接當作每根筋伸長；應先定義量測參考長度及未擾動基準，再比較不同進尺的擠出增量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時；若出現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Ground extruding toward the opening weakens arching, while bonded bars restrain the core. Face movement includes unloading and time effects rather than each bar's extension. Define reference length and an undisturbed datum before comparing extrusion increments at different excavation advances. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

units.practice: 將將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 補強密度與非均勻分擔~Reinforcement density and unequal sharing
units.title: 補強密度與非均勻分擔~Reinforcement density and unequal sharing
units.mechanism: 每支筋對應的面積可描述幾何密度，卻不是固定承載分區。面中心、周邊及薄弱夾層的變形不同，黏結尚未動員的筋可能幾乎不受力；密度比較應同時看長度與岩土變形，避免只用根數評估面穩定。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布；若出現均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Area per bar describes geometric density rather than a fixed load tributary. Centre, edge and weak-layer movements differ, and bars with unmobilized bond may carry little load. Compare density together with length and ground deformation instead of judging face stability from count alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. If uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

units.practice: 將比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸~Fibre material and brittle tension
units.title: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸~Fibre material and brittle tension
units.mechanism: 玻纖複材沿纖維方向強度高，但橫向、彎曲及剪切性能不同，不能套用鋼材的屈服延性。接頭及表面肋形也影響有效承載，名義拉力應以材證與試驗方向配對；沒有明顯塑性警訊時，損傷辨識尤其依賴品質證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷；若出現運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Fibre composites are strong along fibres but differ in transverse, bending and shear behaviour, so steel yielding assumptions do not apply. Connections and surface ribs affect effective resistance. Match certificates to test direction; limited plastic warning makes quality evidence particularly important. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage. If handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 孔壁黏結與有效錨固~Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage
units.title: 孔壁黏結與有效錨固~Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage
units.mechanism: 玻纖筋透過漿體將拉力分散到孔壁，實際界面受孔壁擾動及注漿連續性控制。長度增加不保證線性增加容量，受拉端先動員且可能先軟化；平均黏結公式只能用作初步量級，必須配合拉拔曲線辨認滑移位置。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結；若出現軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Grout distributes bar force to the bore wall, controlled by disturbance and continuity. Longer embedment does not guarantee proportional capacity because the loaded end mobilizes and may soften first. An average-bond estimate provides scale and needs pull curves to identify the slipping interface. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Assess effective bond using pull movement, grout volume and bore-wall condition. If a weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 開挖進尺與保留長度~Advance and retained reinforcement
units.title: 開挖進尺與保留長度~Advance and retained reinforcement
units.mechanism: 每次開挖會切去靠近面的一段筋，剩餘錨固長度隨進尺降低。原始孔長合格不代表下一循環仍有足夠保留量，偏斜和孔底未填也會減少有效段；應建立每一輪補強與實際進尺的幾何帳，而非只記採購長度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐輪比較實測孔長、累積進尺及下一輪補強位置；若出現超進尺把有效黏結段切短，局部擠出突然加快，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Each advance removes the near-face section, reducing retained anchorage. Correct original length does not guarantee the next cycle's effective embedment; deviation and unfilled ends reduce it further. Maintain a geometric record of each reinforcement round and actual advance rather than purchase length alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare measured bore length, accumulated advance and the next reinforcement round. If excess advance shortens effective bond and abruptly accelerates local extrusion, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 鑽孔偏差與地層覆蓋~Bore deviation and ground coverage
units.title: 鑽孔偏差與地層覆蓋~Bore deviation and ground coverage
units.mechanism: 孔口布點均勻不能保證深部補強均勻，傾角誤差會讓孔群逐漸聚集或發散。弱層若位於原預期孔軸之外，筋數再多也不能提供所需拘束；需把三維孔軸與地質模型重疊，辨識未覆蓋體積而非只看正面照片。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置；若出現同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Uniform collars do not ensure deep coverage because angular errors concentrate or separate bores. A weak layer outside the actual axes remains unrestrained despite a high bar count. Overlay three-dimensional axes and geology to identify unreinforced volumes rather than relying on a face photograph. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers. If consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：offset=10 m*tan(0.5 deg)=0.0873 m。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: offset=10 m*tan(0.5 deg)=0.0873 m. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 孔口位置正確就代表深部補強位置一定正確~Correct collar positions guarantee correct deep reinforcement positions
units.practice: 將以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 施工時間與黏結成熟~Construction time and bond maturity
units.title: 施工時間與黏結成熟~Construction time and bond maturity
units.mechanism: 漿體材料需要時間形成可用黏結，低溫或大量水流可能改變成熟速度。表面硬化不能證明深部界面已發展，下一次開挖若過早卸載會在尚弱的錨固中造成滑移；評估要使用與原位環境可比的試體或核准方法。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將原位溫度、材料齡期及可比黏結試驗共同對照；若出現室內成熟資料高估低溫孔內黏結，導致早期滑移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Grout needs time to develop useful bond, with cold or flowing water changing maturity. Surface hardening does not prove deep-interface development. Early unloading in the next advance can slip a weak anchorage, requiring specimens or approved evidence comparable to the installed environment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare in-place temperature, age and representative bond tests. If indoor maturity data overstate cold-bore bond and allow early slip, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 將原位溫度、材料齡期及可比黏結試驗共同對照。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「室內成熟資料高估低溫孔內黏結，導致早期滑移」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare in-place temperature, age and representative bond tests. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Indoor maturity data overstate cold-bore bond and allow early slip. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 室內成熟資料高估低溫孔內黏結，導致早期滑移。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將原位溫度、材料齡期及可比黏結試驗共同對照，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Indoor maturity data overstate cold-bore bond and allow early slip. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare in-place temperature, age and representative bond tests to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 孔口漿體變硬就代表整支錨固已達最終強度~Hard grout at the collar proves final strength along the entire anchorage
units.practice: 將將原位溫度、材料齡期及可比黏結試驗共同對照列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現室內成熟資料高估低溫孔內黏結，導致早期滑移，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare in-place temperature, age and representative bond tests. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If indoor maturity data overstate cold-bore bond and allow early slip, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 多點擠出與變形梯度~Multipoint extrusion and gradients
units.title: 多點擠出與變形梯度~Multipoint extrusion and gradients
units.mechanism: 掌子面單一中心位移只能描述一點，無法辨認深部剪切帶與整體剛體移動。沿深度的多點位移差可建立變形梯度，但標距跨越不同地層時必須分段；量測斷線也可能被誤讀成穩定，因此缺值要保留而非補成零。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較深淺錨點相對位移及通道完整性診斷；若出現深部滑移集中在短區段，平均面位移卻顯得溫和，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~One central displacement cannot distinguish a deep shear band from rigid movement. Differences along depth give deformation gradients but should be segmented across strata. A broken channel may also appear stable, so retain missing values rather than replacing them with zeros. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare relative shallow-deep movement and channel-integrity diagnostics. If deep slip localizes within a short zone despite modest mean face movement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：gradient=(18-6) mm/3000 mm=0.004=0.4 percent。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: gradient=(18-6) mm/3000 mm=0.004=0.4 percent. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 比較深淺錨點相對位移及通道完整性診斷。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「深部滑移集中在短區段，平均面位移卻顯得溫和」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare relative shallow-deep movement and channel-integrity diagnostics. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Deep slip localizes within a short zone despite modest mean face movement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare relative shallow-deep movement and channel-integrity diagnostics to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 掌子面中心位移小就代表整個核心沒有剪切~Small central face movement proves the entire core is free of shear
units.practice: 將比較深淺錨點相對位移及通道完整性診斷列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現深部滑移集中在短區段，平均面位移卻顯得溫和，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare relative shallow-deep movement and channel-integrity diagnostics. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If deep slip localizes within a short zone despite modest mean face movement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 切除材料與施工介面~Cuttable material and excavation interfaces
units.title: 切除材料與施工介面~Cuttable material and excavation interfaces
units.mechanism: 玻纖筋可被開挖設備切除的特性，不表示其碎片或殘端對後續流程沒有影響。材料碎屑可能混入土石與排水系統，殘留筋端也會改變局部接觸；交接須把設計保留段和施工切除段分開，避免把已移除材料仍算入支護。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按循環核對切除長度、殘端位置及排水清理紀錄；若出現資料庫未扣除切去段而高估面前剩餘補強能力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Cuttable reinforcement still affects downstream work through fragments and residual ends. Debris can enter spoil or drainage systems, while remnants alter contact. Distinguish retained design lengths from removed sections so excavation records do not continue crediting reinforcement that no longer exists. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit removed length, remnant positions and drainage-cleaning records by cycle. If a database retaining removed lengths overstates remaining reinforcement ahead of the face, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：removedBarLength=barCount*advance=40*1.5 m=60 m per assumed cycle。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: removedBarLength=barCount*advance=40*1.5 m=60 m per assumed cycle. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 面補強與周邊支護協調~Face reinforcement and peripheral support
units.title: 面補強與周邊支護協調~Face reinforcement and peripheral support
units.mechanism: 面補強抑制核心擠出，周邊初支則限制徑向收斂，兩者作用不同又相互影響。只增加面筋不能補償基腳沉陷或未閉合環，監測應同時追蹤面前與面後；施工判讀須避免把周邊支護問題錯歸因於筋材品質。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步比較面擠出、拱頂沉陷及初支閉合位置；若出現面位移改善卻周邊持續收斂，單一指標掩蓋另一失效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Face bars restrain extrusion while peripheral support limits radial convergence; the mechanisms differ but interact. More face bars cannot compensate for sinking feet or an unclosed ring. Monitor ahead and behind the face to avoid attributing peripheral-support problems solely to bar quality. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare extrusion, crown settlement and initial-support closure position simultaneously. If improved face movement conceals continuing perimeter convergence when only one indicator is used, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：movementRatio=faceExtrusion/crownSettlement=15 mm/5 mm=3, a diagnostic ratio only。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: movementRatio=faceExtrusion/crownSettlement=15 mm/5 mm=3, a diagnostic ratio only. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If improved face movement conceals continuing perimeter convergence when only one indicator is used, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查掌子面擠出與地層核心：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent；再獨立檢查補強密度與非均勻分擔：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。同一 6000 mm 參考長度內，假想擠出由 12 增為 18 mm，平均變形比由 0.2% 增為 0.3%；不是每支筋的相同應變。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 將比較深淺錨點相對位移及通道完整性診斷作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Face extrusion and ground core: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent. Independently check Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar. Over a 6000 mm reference length, extrusion rising from 12 to 18 mm changes the mean deformation ratio from 0.2% to 0.3%; this is not identical strain in every bar. The two results are not a complete design because fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. Use compare relative shallow-deep movement and channel-integrity diagnostics as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的以掌子面擠出、玻纖筋黏結與開挖保留長度控制面補強，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on control face reinforcement through extrusion, fibre-bar bond and retained length reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
facts: 假想檢核 1：掌子面擠出與地層核心；meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent~Assumed check 1: Face extrusion and ground core; meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent
假想檢核 2：補強密度與非均勻分擔；tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar~Assumed check 2: Reinforcement density and unequal sharing; tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar
假想檢核 3：玻纖材料與脆性拉伸；Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN~Assumed check 3: Fibre material and brittle tension; Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN
假想檢核 4：孔壁黏結與有效錨固；N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN~Assumed check 4: Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage; N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN
假想檢核 5：開挖進尺與保留長度；retainedLength=installedLength-advance=12 m-7 m=5 m~Assumed check 5: Advance and retained reinforcement; retainedLength=installedLength-advance=12 m-7 m=5 m
假想檢核 6：鑽孔偏差與地層覆蓋；offset=10 m*tan(0.5 deg)=0.0873 m~Assumed check 6: Bore deviation and ground coverage; offset=10 m*tan(0.5 deg)=0.0873 m
CEDD 岩洞指南第二版出版於 2018 年，並非本課的實測報告~CEDD issued its second cavern guide in 2018; it is not a measurement report for these examples
